logline: A street artist and small-time counterfeiter gets pulled into a high-stakes currency fraud, while a tenacious STF officer closes in from the other side of the system.

pull_quotes.text: Farzi is the first of Raj and DK's projects to feel like a tired imitation rather than its own, vital thing.

seasons.review_body: Farzi premiered on 10 February 2023 and became the most-watched Hindi web series of the year with a reported 37.1 million viewers. The Raj and DK series pairs Shahid Kapoor's street-artist counterfeiter with Vijay Sethupathi's obsessive STF officer, setting up a cat-and-mouse that the directors animate with their trademark tonal fluency. Critical response split along a familiar fault line: sympathetic reviews from Film Companion and Indian outlets cited the assured screenplay and career-best Kapoor; Variety's international notice called it the first Raj and DK project that felt formulaic. The audience sided decisively with the domestic consensus. The eight-episode structure was debated, with Variety noting the plot could have been tighter, but the finale episode scored 9.0 on IMDb, suggesting the payoff landed for viewers who stayed.

episode_reviews.title: Artist
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: Sunny, a struggling street artist, stumbles into counterfeiting as a way out of dead-end poverty; across town, STF officer Michael is obsessing over the same crime network. The Raj-DK debut episode does what their setups do best - all tone, world, and texture before the plot machinery engages.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Sunny's first printed note held to the light - the show's central image and its central question about authenticity made literal.

critic_note.text: Shahid Kapoor and Vijay Sethupathi make a pitch-perfect debut in this Raj and DK crime thriller.

episode_reviews.title: CCFART
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: Sunny's operation escalates beyond anything he planned; Michael starts closing in on threads that will eventually lead to him. The comedic register is at its sharpest here before the plot tightens and squeezes out the levity.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The acronym reveal for CCFART - the episode's best joke and the show telling you not to take it too seriously.

episode_reviews.title: Cat and Mouse
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The hunt between Michael and Sunny enters its tightest corridor; alliances shift and both men understand for the first time what the other is actually capable of. Vijay Sethupathi's Michael peaks in this episode - funny, terrifying, and entirely present.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Michael's interrogation of a middleman - Vijay Sethupathi doing the thing only he can do.

episode_reviews.title: Crash and Burn
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The season finale delivers the confrontation and enough consequences to justify the eight-episode build. Critics noted it as the season's strongest episode; the IMDb rating of 9.0 on the finale confirms the payoff landed for most viewers even where the middle stretched thin.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The final Sunny-Michael standoff - the show's best five minutes, earned across the entire season.
